text:
Samir Patel: Quick design check — putting this 'preflight' modal in the alert composer to let users confirm channel mappings and suppression windows. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/preflight.png

Jia Lin: Love the idea. Two quick concerns: 1) compact layout hides channel descriptions, 2) keyboard focus order looks off when preview toggles.

Marco Ruiz: Agreed on focus. Right now Tab lands on the preview switch then jumps into the channel list in a way that confuses screen readers.

Ada Thompson: Copy nit: header reads 'Confirm routing & suppressions' — feels terse. Suggest 'Confirm notification routing and suppression schedule' to be explicit.

Samir Patel: Good call on copy. Longer header might break mobile. Maybe shorter subtitle that expands on hover?

Jia Lin: Can we show channel icons inline (small) so scanning is faster without full descriptions? Keeps compactness but adds affordance.

Marco Ruiz: For a11y, adding an offscreen description per channel that concatenates channel name + method + last used would help screen readers: e.g., "PagerDuty (push), last used: on-call policy".

Ada Thompson: Also: when suppression is ON, the preview area should update live with a clear live-region update so SRs announce it. Right now there's no announcement.

Samir Patel: Implementation thought — we could reuse the live region we have in notify-sim. Jia, Marco, can we meet to spec the focus order + aria-live text? 15 min?

Jia Lin: Yep, slotting now.

Marco Ruiz: I can prototype a11y text tonight.

DesignBot: small note: analytics event 'preflight_confirmed' fired when user clicks Confirm — consider adding 'preview_shown' and 'suppression_toggled' events for regression tracking :memo:

Ada Thompson: Final microcopy suggestion for Confirm button: instead of 'Confirm' use 'Enable routing' when first time, and 'Save changes' when editing. Slightly clearer.

Samir Patel: Nice. I'll update mocks: shorter header + expanded subtitle, inline icons, aria-live for preview, button text variant. Back here after PR.
